chapter.verse: Tu-a teng khit, leitung kiu li ah vanmi li a ding ka mu hi. Tuate in leitung leh tuipi tungah huih a nun loh nading leh singkung khat nangawn a mutkhak loh nadingin leitung kimkot mun lite lencip uh hi.

Tua ciangin vanmi dang khat, a nungta Pasian' ciaptehna gipa tawi-in ni a suahtohna mun pan a kahto ka mu hi. Amah in leitung leh tuipi siatsak theih nading thu a ngah vanmi lite awging lianpi tawh sam a,
“I Pasian' silate a tal tungah ciaptehna gip i belh khit mateng leitung ahi-a tuipi leh singkungte ahi zongin siasak naikei un,” ci hi.
Tua ciangin ciaptehna gip a kibelh mi phazah genna ka za a, Israel' suan beh khempeuh pan ciaptehna gip a kibelh pen 144,000 pha hi:
Judah beh sungpan ciaptehna gip a kibelh mi 12,000, Reuben beh sungpan 12,000, Gad beh sungpan 12,000,
Asher beh sungpan 12,000, Naphtali beh sungpan 12,000, Manasseh beh sungpan 12,000,
Simeon beh sungpan 12,000, Levi beh sungpan 12,000, Issachar beh sungpan 12,000,
Zebulun beh sungpan 12,000, Joseph beh sungpan 12,000, Benjamin beh sungpan 12,000, tu-a teng ciaptehna gip kibelh hi.

Tu-a teng khit ka khuadak leh kumpi-tokhom leh Tuuno' mai-ah khualmi, minam, tualmi leh kampau a namkim pan kuamah' simzawhloh ding mihon tampi ding uh hi. Amaute in puantual paak silhin a khut uhah nisuh hiangte tawi uh a,
“Hotkhiatna pen kumpi-tokhom tunga tu i Pasian leh Tuuno' a ahi hi,” ci-in awging lianpi tawh kiko uh hi.
Tua ciangin kumpi-tokhom kimkot, makaite' kimkot, leh sahing lite' kimkot ah vanmi khempeuh ding tek uh hi. Amaute in kumpi-tokhom mai, leilak ah a maitang uh matsukin Pasian bia uh a,
“Amen! I Pasian' tungah thupha paihna, minpha, pilna, lungdamkohna, pahtawina, vangliatna leh thahatna, a tawntung a tawntungin om ta hen! Amen,” ci uh hi.
Tua ciangin makaite khat in kei' kiangah, “Hih, puantual paak silhte kua hi-a koi pan hong pai uh ahi hiam?” ci-in hong dong hi.
“Nang'n na thei hi Topa aw,” ka cih leh amah in, “Amau pen gimna lianpi sungpan hong pusuak mite ahi uh hi. A puantual uh sawpsiang khin uh a, Tuuno' sisan tawh paaksak khin uh hi.
“Tua ahih manin amaute Pasian' kumpi-tokhom mai-ah omin a biakinnpi sungah a sun a zan ci lo-in ama' na sem uh a, kumpi-tokhom tunga a tupa in amaute' kiangah phualsat ding hi.
Amaute gilkial ngei nawnlo ding uh a, zong dangtak ngei nawnlo ding uh hi. ni in ahi-a a sa mahmah khatpeuh in ahi zongin amaute sukha lo ding hi.
A hang pen kumpi-tokhom laizanga Tuuno pen amau a cing tuucing hong hiding a, amah in nuntakna tui a luanna tuinakte ah amaute tonpihin Pasian in a mit panun khitui khempeuh nulsiangsak ding hi.”
